note: Independent, implementation-neutral evaluation protocol for causal memory transfer. Pre-registered by the independent audit BEFORE interpreting any Memory v0.7 results. PRecorded from the historical frozen criteria (frozen_eval_criteria_v01/v02) which remain in force unchanged; this protocol governs NEW transfer claims only.

quantities_to_distinguish.retained_memory_benefit: difference caused by knowledge retained from training, isolated from exploration and within-episode learning
quantities_to_distinguish.within_episode_learning: performance gain from learning that occurs during evaluation episodes themselves
quantities_to_distinguish.goal_directed_exploration: performance from planning/exploration built into the agent, independent of retained memory
quantities_to_distinguish.repeated_task_memorization: performance from having seen the same task configuration during training (memorization, not generalization)
quantities_to_distinguish.true_transfer_unseen_structures: performance on task configurations whose causal structure was not present in training
quantities_to_distinguish.negative_transfer: measured performance reduction caused by retained memory relative to the appropriate control

mandatory_control_arms.fresh: untrained policy (same architecture, no training), evaluated under the same protocol
mandatory_control_arms.trained_with_memory: policy trained on the training pool with persistent memory enabled
mandatory_control_arms.trained_memory_wiped: the trained policy with all stored memory erased at evaluation time (same weights/planning)
mandatory_control_arms.shuffled_memory: the trained policy whose stored memory content is scrambled (wrong associations) before evaluation
mandatory_control_arms.planning_only: the same agent with vocabulary/candidate probing disabled but goal planning intact
mandatory_control_arms.matched_budgets: all arms run with identical per-decision compute budgets, same episode streams, same max steps, and reported per-policy CPU

evaluation_rules.observable_information_only: Agent decisions may consume only information observable from the public observation stream and the agent's own retained state. Hidden rules are not passable to the agent at any point during execution.
evaluation_rules.independent_evaluation_labels: Hidden true rules may be used only by the independent evaluation harness to compute correctness/discovery labels, never by the agent.
evaluation_rules.unseen_task_configurations: Transfer claims must be evaluated on task configurations disjoint from training configurations with the split registered before evaluation (see seed/registration rules).
evaluation_rules.evaluation_mode_immutability: Frozen evaluation arms must assert that no learning or memory update occurs during evaluation (counters unmoved).
evaluation_rules.no_protocol_tuning: The protocol and its control arms are fixed at registration; they may not be tuned to the results of any particular implementation.

statistics.paired_seeds: identical seed streams across all control arms in a comparison
statistics.candidate_minus_baseline: all deltas report candidate - baseline (positive = candidate better); baseline per claim is specified in the claim level
statistics.paired_bootstrap_95: paired bootstrap 95% CIs with recorded seed, rounds, alpha; raw per-seed vectors committed
statistics.per_seed_reporting: every headline metric reported as a per-seed vector with population stddev and nonzero-seed count

level_1_preliminary.definition: Directional pilot evidence (e.g. 4 x 40 or 2 train seeds).
evidence: Improvement vs fresh control AND planning-only control (delta positive with candidate - baseline convention)
Measurable retained-memory influence on selected actions (attribution trace shows hypotheses/bank/atom-sourced actions)
Reduced or eliminated benefit in the memory-wiped and shuffled-memory controls
Evaluation on unseen task configurations (registered disjoint split)
Per-seed vectors and paired bootstrap 95% CIs reported; CI including 0 labeled as not a measured population effect
No hidden-rule access during policy execution (harness-level check)
level_1_preliminary.reporting: Must be labeled preliminary; no population-level claim.

level_2_confirmatory.definition: Confirmatory sample size (>=8 seeds x 100 episodes mechanism lab; >=5 train seeds Academy) with all level-1 evidence and CI excluding 0 for the headline delta.
evidence: Paired bootstrap 95% CI for the primary delta excluding 0
Independent recomputation (audit rerun) of the headline figure

negative_and_failure_reporting.negative_transfer: must be reported with the exact cells (candidate vs fresh/planning-only) and CIs; it is a scientific result, not a failure of the protocol
negative_and_failure_reporting.inconclusive: reported as such when metadata is missing (e.g. unrecorded budget/seed/hash) or when a control arm is missing; INCONCLUSIVE is never converted to PASS by fabricating values
negative_and_failure_reporting.protocol_failure: recorded when the evaluation cannot be interpreted (missing arms, overlap, hidden access) - the claim is then not assessable

seed_registration.rule: Evaluation seeds for transfer experiments are listed explicitly in this file and are frozen at registration; no seeds are added after development runs begin.
seed_registration.mechanism: The registered seeds are listed explicitly in this protocol; their origin is the established mechanism-lab world-seed base (11800 + i) documented in the committed v0.12 / v0.12.1 / v0.13 paired studies, so transfer experiments align pairwise with historical evidence. The list is fixed at registration; future experiments must consume these seeds in order.
seed_registration.note: The frozen list provides >=8 seeds for confirmatory mechanism-lab runs and is consumed in order; Academy runs use the Academy eval grid seeds (academy_eval_grid_v01.json) unchanged.

control_role_mapping.description: Manifests of transfer experiments must declare a mapping from the semantic control roles above to their policy/variant names (field `experiment.evaluation.transfer.roles`, an optional section of `experiment.evaluation`). The audit verifies presence, pairwise alignment, and that required roles are distinct.
